annotations.title: Create or Update a Multi-Page Website

description: Create a new single-page or multi-page website or update an existing site on wordy.page. Supports up to 10 pages per site, simple Light or Dark mode (`theme`: "light" or "dark"), one Unsplash header image per page (`photo` on the home page and on each section, which also renders a 50%-opacity blurred full-viewport background), plain-text formatting limited to ALL CAPS blue light-bold highlights (do NOT use **bold** Markdown asterisks) and space/tab indentation (blank lines stay blank, no <hr> dividers), safe plain-text HTML/code escaping, automatic URL/email linking, payment links (PayPal, Venmo, Cash App, Stripe, Square, Google Pay or Zelle) on their own line as a Pay Now button, and an optional contact form on any page (`cf: true` on the home page or a section; Email + Message only). If authenticated with a matching session_token, publishes immediately (`status: "live"`); otherwise emails a one-tap verification/publish link to `owner_email` (`status: "Verify email"`).

from_slug.description: Optional old slug if renaming/moving an existing site you own to a new slug.

login_token.description: Optional 32-character one-time token from an emailed `https://wordy.page/pages?login=<token>` link to redeem and authenticate right away.

owner_email.description: Owner email address (receives the one-tap verification link and any contact form messages; never displayed publicly).

photo.description: Optional single header image for the home page: an Unsplash photo id from `search_photos`. Renders below the page name and above the text, with photographer credit. One image per page.

sections.description: Optional additional sub-pages (up to 9 extra pages, home + 9 = 10 pages total, each given its own URL `/<slug>/<page-slug>/` and navigation menu item).

cf.description: Include a contact form (Email + Message only) at the bottom of this page; messages are emailed to the owner.

photo.description: Optional single header image for this page (Unsplash photo id from `search_photos`).

text.description: Sub-page body text (max 20,000 chars; same plain-text rules as `description`: only indentation and ALL CAPS formatting).

session_token.description: Optional 30-day session token (`st`) if already authenticated for `owner_email`.

slug.description: Target web address slug (3-40 chars, lowercase letters/digits/hyphens), published at https://wordy.page/<slug>/.

title.description: Site name displayed in the sticky top header bar (max 20 characters, so it fits on one line in the header at a 375px phone width; clicks back to the first home page).
